title: Low-Carb Keto Board
seo_title: Low-Carb Keto Charcuterie Board for 6–10: Plan & Shopping
description: A low-carb keto board for 6–10: aged cheddar, Gouda, brie, Parmesan, Genoa salami, prosciutto, bresaola, endive, celery, bacon crisps and berries. No crackers.
hook: Zero crackers, fat-forward and full of flavor: four cheeses and four meats with endive, celery and bacon crisps to carry them.
why: Take away the crackers and the cheese has nowhere to hide, so this board uses four cheeses that cover every texture: crumbly aged cheddar, caramel-like Gouda, creamy brie and intense Parmesan.

Endive leaves are the elegant keto scoop, thick cucumber rounds carry the meat, and baked bacon crisps are the most satisfying cracker swap of all. Berries are the lowest-sugar fruit, so they're the only fruit here.

timeline.what: Bake the bacon crisps; cool them on a rack.
Cube the cheeses; prep the cucumber and endive.
Place the cheeses; set out the dips and mustard.
Fan the meats; add the berries and dippers.

faq.q: What do you put on a keto charcuterie board?
faq.a: Hard and soft cheeses, cured meats, low-carb dippers like endive, celery and cucumber, bacon crisps, berries, nuts, olives, mustard and guacamole.

faq.q: What can replace crackers on keto?
faq.a: Endive leaves, cucumber rounds, celery, bacon crisps and parmesan crisps.
